name: Scholarcy
tagline: Scholarcy is an AI research tool that reads academic papers, reports, and book chapters and produces a structured, skimmable summary — highlighting key findings, methodology, limitations, and references. It exports summaries to a personal library or integrates with reference managers like Zotero. Researchers and graduate students use it to assess the relevance of a paper in minutes rather than reading the full text.
